title: 'perf(line): reduce runtime memory cost'
category: other
requirement: '## Context

  Large line charts can put unnecessary pressure on the browser by holding more runtime memory than the renderer actually needs. Users feel this as slower interaction or higher memory usage rather than as a visible API problem.


  ## Desired outcome

  Reduce the runtime memory footprint of line-series rendering without changing chart appearance, public options, or event behavior.


  ## Acceptance signals

  Equivalent line charts consume less memory during rendering or interaction, visual output remains unchanged, and no public configuration changes are required from chart authors.'
=====
title: 'feat(axis): add `showMinLine` / `showMaxLine` option for `splitLine`'
category: feature
requirement: '## Context

  Some designs need axis split lines only at the lower bound, upper bound, or both boundary lines, especially in compact dashboards where every extra grid line adds clutter. Today authors cannot express that boundary-only behavior directly.


  ## Desired outcome

  Add `showMinLine` and `showMaxLine` to split-line configuration so chart authors can independently control whether the minimum and maximum boundary lines are rendered.


  ## Acceptance signals

  Turning on `showMinLine` or `showMaxLine` renders only the requested boundary split lines, existing split-line behavior remains unchanged when the options are absent, and authors can combine them for both ends when needed.'

visible or API change:

  `Polar#dataToPoint` / `Polar#coordToPoint` gain the optional `out`
  parameter that the coordinate system interface already declares and
  `Cartesian2D` already supports (backward compatible, no caller passes
  it today).
